name: Cube Invasion VR
summary:
Build the battlefield. Prepare your army. Then step inside and fight.

Cube Invasion VR combines hands-on building, strategy, and first-person VR combat. Fight through 10 handcrafted battlefields featuring soldiers, archers, siege weapons, destructible fortifications, and a wide selection of medieval weapons.

When you are ready to create your own battles, enter the level builder. Construct castles and defensive positions block by block, place units, assign their roles, and design your own combat scenarios.
